name: Findroid
summary: Native Jellyfin client focused on offline downloads and Material You

description.en: A third-party Jellyfin client built with native Android UI instead of a webview: fast, Material You themed, with solid offline download support and external player integration.
description.pt: Cliente Jellyfin de terceiros construído com interface nativa em vez de webview: rápido, com tema Material You, bom suporte de downloads offline e integração com reprodutores externos.

author: Jarne Demeulemeester

summaryTranslations.pt: Cliente Jellyfin nativo com foco em downloads offline e UI Material You
